subject: Interakt and the rest of it
body:
Hi there,

I am a founding engineer at wrrk.ai and I built the WhatsApp side, so I notice this stuff. You are paying for Interakt, which handles WhatsApp and stops there. Your email, your Instagram DMs and your deal history live somewhere else, so nobody has the whole conversation in one place. We built the version where all of it lands on one contact record. Same WhatsApp number, nothing to migrate.

Worth 15 minutes? I can show it with your own numbers in it.

Wachas
Founding engineer, wrrk.ai
linkedin: I am a founding engineer at wrrk.ai. Saw you run Interakt. Curious how you handle email and Instagram alongside it, since that is the seam most teams tell us hurts. Happy to compare notes.
evidence: 5 front doors; WhatsApp is a live channel; WhatsApp + Instagram both open; pays for Interakt (WhatsApp only, no CRM behind it); running paid ads into those channels
